description: Master the Bootstrap 5 layout and grid system: containers, 12-column grid, breakpoints (sm to xxl), gutters, row-cols, and nesting.

slides.title: Introduction to Bootstrap 5
slides.content:
# Welcome to Bootstrap 5 🅱️

**Bootstrap** is the world's most popular open-source front-end toolkit for developing responsive, mobile-first websites. Created at Twitter in 2011, Bootstrap 5 represents a complete modern overhaul.

## What's New in Bootstrap 5?
- **Zero jQuery**: Completely rewritten in vanilla JavaScript for maximum speed and compatibility.
- **CSS Custom Properties**: Native CSS variables support for dynamic theme switching.
- **Enhanced 12-Column Grid**: New XXL breakpoint (`>= 1400px`) and standalone gutter utilities (`g-*`, `gx-*`, `gy-*`).
- **Modern Utility API**: Built on Sass maps to add, remove, or modify utility classes effortlessly.
- **Offcanvas Component**: Native drawer navigation for mobile interfaces.

slides.title: Containers: Fixed vs Fluid
slides.content:
# Bootstrap Containers 📦 Containers are the most fundamental layout element in Bootstrap. They wrap, pad, and align your content within a given device or viewport. ## Container Types | Class | Behavior | Max Width | |---|---|---| | `.container` | Responsive fixed-width container | Snaps to max-width at each breakpoint (540px, 720px, 960px, 1140px, 1320px) | | `.container-fluid` | Full width container | `width: 100%` across all viewport sizes | | `.container-{breakpoint}` | 100% wide until specified breakpoint | E.g. `.container-md` is 100% wide until `768px`, then becomes fixed | ```html_not

Welcome to Bootstrap 5

Centered with automatic horizontal padding (15px gutters on each side).

```

slides.title: The 6 Grid Breakpoints
slides.content:
# The 6 Responsive Breakpoints 📱💻

Bootstrap uses a mobile-first responsive system powered by 6 tiered media query breakpoints.

## Breakpoint Reference Table

| Breakpoint | Infix | Dimensions | Target Devices |
|---|---|---|---|
| Extra small | *(none)* | `< 576px` | Portrait smartphones |
| Small | `sm` | `>= 576px` | Landscape phones, small tablets |
| Medium | `md` | `>= 768px` | Tablets, iPads |
| Large | `lg` | `>= 992px` | Laptops, desktop monitors |
| Extra large | `xl` | `>= 1200px` | Large desktop displays |
| Extra extra large | `xxl` | `>= 1400px` | High-res & ultrawide screens |

> 💡 **Mobile-First Principle:** Classes without an infix (like `.col-6`) apply from `0px` upward until overridden by a larger infix (like `.col-md-4`).

slides.title: The 12-Column Grid Anatomy
slides.content:
# Anatomy of the 12-Column Grid 📐 The Bootstrap grid builds on Flexbox. A grid consists of **three nested levels**: ``` .container (or .container-fluid) └── .row (wraps columns & applies negative margin gutters) └── .col-* (the immediate children holding content) ``` ## Basic Grid Example ```html_not
Spans 8 of 12 columns
Spans 4 of 12 columns
``` > ⚠️ **Strict Rule:** Only `.col-*` should be immediate children of `.row`, and all content belongs inside columns!

slides.title: Auto-Layout & Equal-Width Columns
slides.content:
# Auto-Layout Columns with `.col` ⚖️ If you don't specify explicit column numbers, Bootstrap divides available row space equally. ```html_not
Column 1 of 3
Column 2 of 3
Column 3 of 3
1 of 3
Variable width content
3 of 3
``` `.col-auto` sizes itself precisely to the width of its content, while sibling `.col` elements share the remaining space.

slides.title: Gutters: Spacing Between Columns
slides.content:
# Gutters: `g-*`, `gx-*`, and `gy-*` 📐 Gutters are the padding between columns, created by horizontal padding on `.col` elements and negative margins on `.row`. ## Gutter Utilities (Scale 0 to 5) - `g-0`: Remove all gutters completely (no gaps) - `g-3`: Default Bootstrap gutter (`1.5rem` / `24px`) - `gx-4`: Sets horizontal column gutters only - `gy-4`: Sets vertical gutters between wrapping rows - Responsive: `g-2 g-md-4 g-lg-5` ```html_not
Wide horizontal gap
Wide horizontal gap
```

slides.title: Nesting Columns
slides.content:
# Nesting Grid Columns 🪆 To nest content inside an existing column, insert a new `.row` directly inside a `.col-*`. ```html_not

Main Article (Level 1)

Nested col-6
Nested col-6
Sidebar (Spans 3 of 12)
```

slides.title: Row Columns: Auto-Grid Rows
slides.content:
# Row Columns: `row-cols-*` 🗂️ Instead of adding `.col-md-4` to every single item, specify the column count directly on the parent `.row`! ```html_not
Card 1
Card 2
Card 3
Card 4
``` > ⚡ **Massive Time Saver:** When rendering lists or database items, apply `row-cols-*` to the container and give each card a simple `class="col"`!

slides.title: Column Offset & Alignment
slides.content:
# Offsets & Column Alignment 🎯 ## 1. Column Offsetting (`offset-*`) Move columns to the right by specifying offset increments: ```html_not
Centered Form
``` ## 2. Vertical Alignment (`align-items-*`) Align columns vertically inside the row: `align-items-start`, `align-items-center`, `align-items-end`. ## 3. Horizontal Justification (`justify-content-*`) `justify-content-center`, `justify-content-between`, `justify-content-end`.

slides.content:
# Column Reordering: `order-*` 🔀 Control visual presentation order independently of source HTML order using Flexbox `order` utilities. ```html_not

Main Article Content

``` Bootstrap supports `.order-1` through `.order-5`, plus `.order-first` and `.order-last`.

slides.title: Stand-Alone CSS Grid System in BS5
slides.content:
# Stand-Alone CSS Grid in Bootstrap 5 🔲 In addition to the standard Flexbox grid, Bootstrap 5 includes an optional native CSS Grid system enabled via `$enable-cssgrid: true`. ```html_not
Item 1
Item 2
Item 3
``` Uses `.grid` instead of `.row`, and `.g-col-*` instead of `.col-*` without negative row margins.

slides.title: Common Layout Gotchas in Bootstrap
slides.content:
# Common Grid Gotchas & Solutions ⚠️ ## 1. Margin Collapsing or Overflowing Rows Placing a `.row` outside of a `.container` causes horizontal scrollbars because `.row` has negative horizontal margins (`-12px`). **Fix:** Always wrap `.row` inside `.container` or `.container-fluid`. ## 2. Content Directly Inside `.row` Writing `

Title

` breaks Flexbox alignment. **Fix:** Wrap the title in `

Title

`.

slides.title: Grid Best Practices Checklist
slides.content:
# Grid Best Practices Checklist 📋

- [x] **Always wrap rows in containers**: `.container` prevents horizontal overflow.
- [x] **Columns add up to 12**: Ensure `.col-*` increments per row sum to 12 unless intentional wrapping is desired.
- [x] **Use `row-cols-*` for lists**: Cleaner markup than repeating `.col-md-4` on 20 elements.
- [x] **Leverage mobile-first classes**: Write `.col-12 .col-md-6` instead of desktop-down overrides.
- [x] **Tune gutters with `g-*`**: Don't use manual margins inside grid columns.

slides.title: Summary: Layout & Grid System
slides.content:
# Layout & Grid System: Summary 📋

## Key Takeaways
- **Containers**: Fixed `.container` vs full-bleed `.container-fluid`.
- **Breakpoints**: 6 tiers (`xs`, `sm`, `md`, `lg`, `xl`, `xxl`).
- **Grid Columns**: 12-column flexbox grid with auto-layout (`.col`).
- **Gutters**: Configured with `g-*`, `gx-*`, and `gy-*` on the row.
- **Flexbox Alignment**: `justify-content-*` and `align-items-*`.
